name: Tere Liye
description: Tere Liye was a highly popular Indian television drama series that aired on STAR Plus from June 14, 2010, to April 2, 2011. It had fierce competition with Uttaran airing at the same time on rival channel. It is ranked eighth of all time on Star Plus, currently it is aired on Kohinoor TV of Pakistan .
